words: Builder switch (Nick 2026-10-15, 'sounds good, lets go with that approach'): from stage 5 part 3 on, Codex (gpt-6-astra) is the sole builder for every stage except stage 7 (surface/look), with the orchestrator as critic reading every pass and returning a concrete defect list; Opus returns for stage 7. The two-stream comparison ends; its data stays as the record.
